headline: EPS more than doubles sequentially and rises year-over-year
summary_short: Sumitomo Realty & Development reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ¥92.20, up 126.4% q/q and up 16.8% y/y.
summary_long: EPS of ¥92.20 rose 126.4% sequentially from ¥40.72 and 16.8% year-over-year from ¥78.96. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data.
